lessons.goal: 追蹤條件式安排及最後通知的效力。

questions.evidence: Band chat: We plan to practice in the courtyard tomorrow at four. If rain is falling at three thirty, we will move to Room 102. Please check the teacher's message at that time. A morning forecast alone will not decide which space we use.
questions.explanation: 第一段指定三點半看老師通知。
options: At four the previous morning.
Only after practice ends.
Whenever any app updates.
questions.prompt: When is the location decision checked?

questions.evidence: At three thirty, the teacher posts: It is raining now. Use Room 102 and bring only instruments that fit through its narrow doorway. Large drums will stay in the music room, and we will practice their parts with a small drum instead.
questions.explanation: 門窄，大鼓留音樂教室改小鼓練聲部。
options: Only large drums enter Room 102.
A small drum replaces the large drums for practice.
Every instrument is replaced by a phone.
All instruments are left outside.
questions.prompt: Which equipment changes in the indoor plan?

questions.evidence: Felix: The weather app shows rain, so I told my friend to go straight to Room 102. Leader: Please correct that message. The room is only our backup until the teacher checks the conditions. We want everyone to use the same final instruction.
questions.explanation: 早上預報不足以把備案當正式安排。
options: The courtyard has no address.
The teacher has canceled all practice.
He treated a backup as the final decision too early.
Room 102 can never be used.
questions.prompt: Why should Felix correct his earlier message?

questions.evidence: Felix: The weather app shows rain, so I told my friend to go straight to Room 102. Leader: Please correct that message. The room is only our backup until the teacher checks the conditions. We want everyone to use the same final instruction.
questions.explanation: 下雨才啟用的替代地點。
options: A second teacher who never sends messages.
An alternative used if the main plan cannot proceed.
A recording from last year's concert.
A permanent ban on outdoor practice.

questions.evidence:
Band chat: We plan to practice in the courtyard tomorrow at four. If rain is falling at three thirty, we will move to Room 102. Please check the teacher's message at that time. A morning forecast alone will not decide which space we use.

Felix: The weather app shows rain, so I told my friend to go straight to Room 102. Leader: Please correct that message. The room is only our backup until the teacher checks the conditions. We want everyone to use the same final instruction.

At three thirty, the teacher posts: It is raining now. Use Room 102 and bring only instruments that fit through its narrow doorway. Large drums will stay in the music room, and we will practice their parts with a small drum instead.

Felix forwards the complete message rather than only the room number. He adds that tomorrow's outdoor plan remains unchanged unless a new notice appears. The group now knows today's location, the equipment adjustment, and where to look for the next update.
questions.explanation: 地點之外還有器材限制，不能只傳教室號碼。
options: It makes tomorrow's plan automatically indoor.
It cancels the check time for every future day.
The room number alone leaves out equipment instructions.
It proves forecasts never help.
questions.prompt: Why forward the complete final message?

questions.explanation: 對話強調不同狀態資訊的效力。
options: The teacher's phone from the weather app's logo.
A forecast, a conditional backup, and a confirmed instruction.
Every morning message from every unrelated photograph.
All rooms from all types of instruments only.
